title: Pallet stacks at the ramp no higher than three
explanation_template: Pallet stack higher than three pallets at the ramp since {time}.
unsupported: Stack height is not a primitive. The engine can count objects in a zone (count_in_zone) and tell how high an object's lowest point is above the floor (height_above_floor), but not how many pallets sit on top of each other or where the top of a stack is. A stack is also often segmented as one object.
suggested_rewrite: No more than 6 pallets in the ramp zone. (This limits clutter at the ramp, not stack height; checking height needs a new primitive for the top of an object.)
